training_use: internal synthetic templates and Kale's own FRC parts catalog only

cots_part_data.what_is_used: Published outside dimensions, mass, channel counts, gear ratios and electrical ratings, restated as nominal engineering facts.
cots_part_data.what_is_not_used: Vendor CAD, meshes, drawings, marketing prose and documentation text. Geometry is procedurally rebuilt from published dimensions.
cots_part_data.accuracy_stance: Every catalog entry carries a `verify` field and every generated BOM repeats it. Envelopes are for packaging and first-order sizing, not for machining.

references.name: FIRST Robotics Competition season materials
references.usage: topic and constraint coverage; rules are not copied into training examples

references.name: FRCDesign Design Handbook and Mechanism Examples
references.usage: mechanism vocabulary and review checklist coverage; prose and CAD are not copied
